in_marathi.name: Ramveer
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Ram with great courage
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ramveer हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Ramveer is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ram' which means 'God' and 'Veer' which means 'brave' or 'courageous'. The name signifies a person who has great courage and is fearless in the face of adversity. In Hindu mythology, Lord Rama is considered an embodiment of strength, courage, and victory.
